summary: Make the Toolbar compact and horizontally scrollable, refine progressive panel glass, and expand privacy-safe Emoji gap diagnostics.

changes.title: Scroll Toolbar actions horizontally
changes.detail: The Toolbar now presents its tools in one compact horizontal rail instead of a tall four-column grid. Large gray icon cards are removed, labels stay visible, and the existing tool actions, ordering, and drag-reorder behavior remain available.

changes.title: Refine progressive panel glass
changes.detail: Toolbar and Clipboard share a smoother translucent top fade that clears progressively over the scrolling content. No host-app screenshot or clipboard copy is created by the panel glass.

changes.title: Reuse Emoji context work on panel open
changes.detail: Emoji opening reads one bounded context snapshot and shares one ranking pass between the Smart row and Recents ordering. The existing local privacy checks and explicit Emoji insertion behavior remain in place; no ContextLM or voice model weights are added.

changes.title: Measure Emoji panel layout without capturing content
changes.detail: The one-shot Emoji geometry trace now includes measured and on-screen bounds, parent padding, layout margins, translations, scroll offsets, and system, IME, and gesture insets. It records no typed text, app identity, Emoji contents, or screenshots, making it possible to isolate the Reno10 top gap from actual layout evidence.
